newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile economy grew 4-5 pct in Q1 - cenbank president.
newsitem.headline: Chile economy grew 4-5 pct in Q1 - cenbank president.

text.p: Chile's economy expanded at an annual rate of four to five percent in the first quarter, less than the official target of 5.5 percent to six percent for the year, Central Bank President Carlos Massad told Reuters on Friday.
The economy grew by "between four and five percent" in the January-March quarter, Massad said. The growth rate was no cause for concern, he said, "on the contrary this is what we expected."
"This adjustment has been the the gentlest of all the adjustment processes carried out in recent years," he said, referring to the slowdown in the Chilean economy in recent months.
